name: Miller House
address: 511 South Eighth Street, Springfield, Sangamon County, IL

location.how: centre of the building's outline clicked by hand on the public ortho il-2025-blk3-west (2025, 0.152 m/px), pixel (372, 704)

standing.note: West side of Eighth Street south of Jackson Street (the Lincoln Home site plan, HABS il0382, puts Miller there between Sprigg and Dubois). Identified by its roof: the low hip with a flat deck (the drawing's 'roof top') reads 101 x 71 px (15.4 x 10.8 m) against the drawn main block of 46 ft 5 in x 32 ft 4 in plus a 2.1 ft overhang each side (15.4 x 11.1 m), with the lower rear wing to the west. No addition seen. NPS-owned (Lincoln Home NHS).

plan.note: Outside face of the walls as the dimension strings take it. Start at the main block's sheet top-left corner (rear, south), walk clockwise. Two-story frame house, main block 32'-4" across the front with an 11" step in the north wall, and a two-story rear wing (stair, kitchen) 17'-3" x 7'-10". The strings disagree by 3" on the main block's depth (left 46'-8", right 30'-1" + 16'-4" = 46'-5"); the right side is used, matching the second floor (left 46'-7", right 46'-6") and both of its overalls (54'-3"); see flags.

flags.note: First floor (sheet 2) left string prints 46'-8" for the main block's depth (overall 54'-6"), the right string 30'-1" + 16'-4" = 46'-5" (overall 54'-3"). Measured between the strings' own end ticks the left is 54.34 ft and the right 54.08 ft, so the drawing itself differs; the left string's bottom tick (7043 px) does not line up with the front wall's drawn faces (about 7015-7020 and 7053-7068 px), the right string's (7020 px) does. The right side is used (the second floor gives 54'-3" on both sides). With the left value the outline would be 0.25 ft deeper on one side and would not close.
The front wall is drawn with an inner line at about 7015 px and an outer line at about 7053-7068 px; the side strings end near the inner one. Not resolved; the printed strings are used.
